label: diffuse token-combination unit (copy outputs f/z/3; after i/y in input)
explanation: Fires on about 5% of steps, spread across the original phase (38% of mass) and the copy phase (59%). It never fires at t=0 and rarely at the delimiter, and its rate rises toward the end of long copies. In the copy phase it is enriched when the token being output is f (5.5x), z or 3, and when the input is q; the top activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) are copy steps with input q that output f, z or 3. In the original phase it is enriched just after i or y. These are only enrichments. No simple predicate does well: the best mixed disjunction gets dev F1 0.25 (precision 0.20, mass recall 0.39), and single clauses such as out_tok in {f,z,3} reach only F1 about 0.2. The unit looks like a distributed code over combinations of recent and upcoming tokens, not one interpretable condition.
